presentation.speaker: ines
presentation.title: Customs hold
lines: Parcel {order} is held. Duty: {tax}; full correction penalty: {fine}. Correct the documents, pay now, or withdraw the goods.
An unresolved hold is withdrawn after 7 days; the freight remains paid.

choices.label: Correct the documents and pay a reduced penalty
choices.detail: Pay the duty plus half the correction fine; add 2 days to delivery.
choices.outcome: Documents corrected; duty paid and delivery delayed by 2 days.

choices.label: Pay duty and the full penalty now
choices.detail: Pay the duty and full correction fine; release the parcel immediately.
choices.outcome: Duty and penalty paid. The parcel continues on its international route.

choices.label: Withdraw the parcel
choices.detail: Recover the goods; lose the freight already paid. No sale or payout is claimed.
choices.outcome: The goods are back in stock. Freight remains an expense.
